summary: PagSeguro Digital Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 21, 2026, announcing the resignation of founder and Chairman Luis Frias, effective immediately, after nine years on the board. Frias remains the indirect controlling shareholder. The board appointed existing director Maria Judith de Brito as Chairman and reconfirmed Eduardo Alcaro as Vice-Chairman, effective upon resignation. The board now includes seven directors, three of whom are independent. No financial terms were disclosed. This governance event is notable for the abrupt departure of a founder and controlling shareholder from formal board leadership, with implications for shareholder alignment and future strategic direction. Watch for any subsequent board actions or shareholder reactions.
